/--Let \( \alpha \) be a non-zero complex number such that \( \alpha + \alpha^{-1} \) is contained
in a quadratic number field. Let \( L \) be the normal closure of \( \mathbb{Q}(\alpha) \). Show
that \( [L : \mathbb{Q}] \) divides \( 8 \).-/
theorem finrank_dvd_eight_of_add_inv_eq_algebraMap {α : ℂ} {K L : Type} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Algebra K ℂ] (hk : Module.finrank ℚ K = 2) {a : K} (h : α + α⁻¹ = algebraMap K ℂ a)
    [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L] [IsNormalClosure ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ L] : Module.finrank ℚ L ∣ 8 := by
  have hfa : Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ ∣ 2 := by
    rw [← hk]
    exact ⟨Module.finrank (↥ℚ⟮a⟯) K, (Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (↥ℚ⟮a⟯) K).symm⟩
  have hnormal : Normal ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ := by
    rcases hfa with ⟨k, hk2⟩
    interval_cases k
    · simp at hk2
      have : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ := Module.finrank_pos
      omega
    · have h1 : Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ = 2 := by omega
      exact IntermediateField.normal_of_finrank_eq_two h1
    · have h1 : Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ = 1 := by omega
      have hbot : ℚ⟮a⟯ = ⊥ := by
        rw [← IntermediateField.finrank_eq_one_iff] at h1
        exact h1
      rw [hbot]
      infer_instance
  have hL : Module.finrank ℚ L = Module.finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ := by
    have e : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] ℚ⟮a⟯ := (IsNormalClosure.equiv ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ L ℚ⟮a⟯).symm
    exact LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e.toLinearEquiv
  rw [hL]
  exact dvd_trans hfa (by norm_num)

/-- Prove that every field automorphism of $\mathbb{R}$ that fixes $\mathbb{Q}$ is trivial. -/
theorem real_algEquiv_eq_one (f : ℝ ≃ₐ[ℚ] ℝ) : f = 1 := by
  have fnonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x := by
    intro x hx
    have hsq : x = (Real.sqrt x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq]
      exact (Real.mul_self_sqrt hx).symm
    rw [hsq]
    rw [map_pow]
    exact sq_nonneg _
  have fmono : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → f a ≤ f b := by
    intro a b hab
    have h1 : 0 ≤ b - a := by linarith
    have h2 : 0 ≤ f (b - a) := fnonneg _ h1
    have h3 : f (b - a) = f b - f a := by rw [map_sub]
    linarith [h3 ▸ h2]
  have fq : ∀ q : ℚ, f ((q : ℝ)) = (q : ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have := f.commutes q
    simpa using this
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  show f x = x
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · -- f x < x
    obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hlt
    have hmono := fmono (q : ℝ) x (le_of_lt hq2)
    rw [fq q] at hmono
    linarith
  · -- x < f x
    obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hgt
    have hmono := fmono x (q : ℝ) (le_of_lt hq1)
    rw [fq q] at hmono
    linarith

/- If $F$ is a field that is not perfect, show that $F$ has a nontrivial purely inseparable
extension.-/
theorem exists_isPurelyInseparable_and_bot_lt {F : Type} [Field F] (h : ¬ PerfectField F) :
    ∃ E : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F), IsPurelyInseparable F E ∧ ⊥ < E := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ExpChar.exists F
  cases hp with
  | zero =>
    exact (h inferInstance).elim
  | prime hp_prime =>
    haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp_prime⟩
    haveI hpe : ExpChar F p := ExpChar.prime hp_prime
    have hns : ¬ Function.Surjective (frobenius F p) := by
      intro hsurj
      have : PerfectRing F p := PerfectRing.ofSurjective F p hsurj
      exact h (PerfectRing.toPerfectField F p)
    have key : ∃ a : F, ∀ x : F, x ^ p ≠ a := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hns
      intro a
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hcon a
      exact ⟨x, by simpa [frobenius_def] using hx⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := key
    set K := AlgebraicClosure F with hK
    have hppos : 0 < p := hp_prime.pos
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (algebraMap F K a) hppos
    have hαnot : ∀ b : F, algebraMap F K b ≠ α := by
      intro b hb
      have h1 : (algebraMap F K b) ^ p = α ^ p := by rw [hb]
      rw [hα] at h1
      have h2 : algebraMap F K (b ^ p) = algebraMap F K a := by
        rw [map_pow]; exact h1
      have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap F K) := RingHom.injective _
      exact ha b (hinj h2)
    refine ⟨IntermediateField.adjoin F {α}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · -- pure inseparability
      have hmem : α ^ p ^ 1 ∈ (algebraMap F K).range := by
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        rw [pow_one, hα]
      exact (IntermediateField.isPurelyInseparable_adjoin_simple_iff_pow_mem F K p).mpr ⟨1, hmem⟩
    · -- ⊥ < E
      rw [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]
      intro hE
      have hαE : α ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin F ({α} : Set K) :=
        IntermediateField.subset_adjoin F _ (Set.mem_singleton α)
      rw [hE] at hαE
      rw [IntermediateField.mem_bot] at hαE
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hαE
      exact hαnot b hb
